revision_scope: This release checks 60 of the 496 table/year source partitions in the baseline and updates 30 partitions to final or revised data. The remaining 436 partitions and all other unchanged data are preserved. This is a limited revision update, not a complete historical refresh.
cost_vintage: 2024 collection/files, provisional. COST1 includes 2021-22 through 2024-25 cost-of-attendance fields and 2024-25 student charges; COST2 documentation is for average net price 2023-24. Column periods vary; year 2024 is the file/collection label.
cost_typing: unitid BIGINT after proving exact canonical decimal representation; year BIGINT=2024 is collection/file year, not the reporting period of every field. Every other original field VARCHAR to preserve codes, formatting, missing strings and values without numeric coercion. Empty source strings remain empty strings, not NULL. Original source names mapped case-insensitively to lowercase; no field renaming beyond case.
validation: All 23 existing source tables exactly preserved from bounded revision candidate by schema/count/aggregate row hash. All old metadata rows preserved. New Cost tables exactly equal audited sidecar by full-row multiset comparison, identical schemas, actual counts verified. Existing view definitions unchanged and queried successfully.
limitations: Source equality is after existing harmonization and projection, not raw CSV equality. HD close_date remains DOUBLE and loses date strings; HD is unchanged. GR line remains numeric and loses labels 29A / 12A / 18A / 11A; GR 2023 final revision changes counts but not the lost label categories.
review_status: The report records the dataset scope and completed validation checks.
